Decoders:
 V..... = Video
 A..... = Audio
 ------
 VFS..D h264                 H.264 / AVC / MPEG-4 AVC / MPEG-4 part 10
 VFS..D vp8                  On2 VP8
 VFS..D vp9                  Google VP9
 V....D libvpx               libvpx VP8 (codec vp8)
 A....D opus                 Opus
 A....D libopus              libopus Opus (codec opus)
